messages:
Aisha (PM): Quick sprint radar check — model-catalog onboarding status. We have 3 new open models in the intake queue that we were hoping to include in next week's catalog launch: Orchid-2.7B, Marlin-7B-fork, Sable-1.1. Blocking items: license confirmation (Legal), perf profile + evals (Eng-ML), runtime compatibility (Runtime). Can owners/engs ping status? If any of these need legal exceptions or runtime kernel work, that could block the Monday EOD milestone.

Ravi (ML Eng): I'm taking Orchid perf. Did a light run on staging this morning — p50/p95 within expected range using quantized profile. I'll upload the perf YAML and eval diffs by EOD. Quick note: batch_size=8, seq=512 gave stable latency.

Claire (Legal): I can start on Marlin license. From a cursory look there is a clause that might restrict redistribution of weights. @Tess can you drop the exact license file or repo link here so I can confirm?

Tess (Curator): Repo/link: https://git.internal/models/marlin-7b (README + LICENSE in root). Also opened PR #42 for a tokenizer encoding mismatch for Sable that explains a few eval flakiness points.

Marco (Runtime Eng): Heads-up: Marlin uses rotary-style positional encodings that our optimized kernel doesn't fully support yet. We can enable a software fallback (`use_rotary_fallback=true`) on dedicated pools to keep latency acceptable, but it costs ~8-12% more tokens. ETA for kernel work: Tues AM. Can we ship with fallback in the short term?

Aisha (PM): Fallback seems workable as a temporary measure — shipping with `use_rotary_fallback=true` and a note in the catalog about perf delta. @Claire if Marlin needs a legal exception that will be a hard blocker. Otherwise, plan B: ship Orchid + Sable (if tokenizer PR merged) and gate Marlin behind legal.

Ravi (ML Eng): Uploaded Orchid perf here: https://redwood.app/perf/orchid-2.7b.yaml — no quality regressions against our reference eval. For Sable, tokenizer PR affects preprocessing; evals are noisy until that's merged. Recommend we hold Sable embeddings rollout until PR is in.

Claire (Legal): I pinged upstream for clarification on the Marlin license clause (asked for written confirmation on commercial use). If they confirm, no exception needed. Targeting reply by EOD.

OncallBot: deploy-bot: Staging deploy for orchid-2.7b succeeded at 1716130300 :white_check_mark:

Marco (Runtime Eng): We'll flip the fallback flag on the dedicated pool for Marlin tonight and add a telemetry metric `rotary_fallback_count` so we can track perf hit. I'll post the rollout config after it's live.

Aisha (PM): TL;DR / action items: 
- Claire -> confirm Marlin license upstream by 1716132000 (if negative, escalate).
- Tess -> merge tokenizer PR for Sable (PR #42) and confirm CI passes.
- Marco -> enable rotary fallback on dedicated pools and share config/telemetry.
- Ravi -> finalize perf YAMLs and attach eval diffs for Orchid + Sable (post-PR).
If all clear, aim to include Orchid in the Monday catalog push; Marlin conditional on legal; Sable conditional on PR. Thanks everyone :pray:
